sections.title: Daily routines and changed schedules: meaning and form
body: Goal: Explain a normal routine, sequence a busy day and respond when the schedule changes.
Core vocabulary: en vardag, hinna, vanligtvis. Key phrases: Jag brukar lämna barnen klockan åtta. · Efter jobbet handlar jag. · Till slut förbereder jag nästa dag.

Frequency adverbs usually follow the finite verb in a main clause: Jag tränar ofta efter jobbet. When another element begins the sentence, the verb comes before the subject: Efter jobbet handlar jag. Sequence a process with först, sedan, därefter and till slut.
Say the examples aloud, notice the pattern, and then change one detail rather than memorising a fixed script.

body: Register model: “Jag blir ungefär tio minuter sen.” is a neutral update way to express “I will be about ten minutes late.”.
For listening and reading, answer from a specific word or phrase. For speaking and writing, make the recipient, purpose and next action clear.
Attempt the task before using the model. Improve one high-impact feature, then perform it again with the transfer condition.

assignment.title: Four-skill task and transfer
assignment.instructions:
LISTEN: First listen without a transcript. Answer: Who will drop off the children tomorrow? Replay once and identify the exact words that prove the answer.

READ: Read for purpose and evidence. Answer: Why does Leo order food online? Mark the shortest phrase that supports your choice.

SPEAK: Describe a normal weekday in order, then explain two changes caused by an unexpectedly early meeting. Make a first attempt, check clarity and repeat once.

WRITE: Write a practical daily plan with five stages and a short backup plan for one delay. Check reader, purpose, required details and next action.

TRANSFER: Public transport is delayed by thirty minutes; decide what can move and notify one affected person.

BETWEEN LESSON · Optional, 5 minutes: retrieve the three key phrases without looking, then use one in a new sentence.
